text_block_list.text:
The debut race. The day had finally arrived
for T.M. Opera O to unveil her running style to the world.

It's finally... the Debut Race...
I wonder if I'll really be okay...

"As long as I can start properly, it should be fine, but
...even so, I'm still... Auuu..."
choice_data_list: T.M. Opera O? A new look!?

text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaa...! I'm sorry, I'm so sorry...
I-I'm not Opera O-san."

"My name is Meisho Doto...
Umm... I'm a friend of Opera O-san's..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san might not think of me as a friend, but...
I'm here to cheer for her today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Umm, well... it looks like they haven't
arrived yet. So, I'm kind of worried...

It seems she's late on the very first day.
...And by quite a lot, too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't my dear Trainer.
Did you wait? You did, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
After all, I made you wait on purpose.
Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing of the sort.
I delayed my arrival at the venue on purpose.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: If the lead were the very first to arrive at the venue, wouldn't it make everyone around them feel unnecessarily tense?
...It seems she did it entirely on purpose.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the Make Debut! The day has finally come to display
this beauty and speed before the eyes of the world!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It feels like we're going to make so much more than just a debut!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Legends, worship—and love!
choice_data_list: Aren't you getting a bit too invested...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Love...
You are truly amazing, Opera O...
Some girls just blindly believe it out of sheer momentum.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Shall we be off, my Trainer?
The era yearns for a new shining star.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about the run. So make sure you're
thoroughly prepared for the post-race press conference, okay?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The media will surely come swarming in!
Bwahaha!
